scope: deterministic identification of an explicitly known fixed clean ordinary equipment result; not the original random additional-property system

provenance.ordinary_template_level_to_quote: client_verified original field/copy/getter chain, six real50level samples
provenance.original_server_random_formula: unknown; this policy explicitly supports a deterministic fixed-result subset

admission: same current role/login/connection/map generations and full-address NPC proof as the accepted original mode1 query; selected positive signed32 item key must be in that frozen queried vector. The wire has no NPC key, price, column, quote version or retry ID; server ticket supplies context. Fresh confirmation rechecks actual NPC and role modal state outside SQL, then current lease/item/asset version in SQL
invalidation: observed movement, other menu, transfer, battle, disconnect or generation replacement revokes uncommitted ticket; changing inventory_revision requires a new query; expired or rejected operation charges nothing
profile: already persisted equipment-detail.1 with origin explicit_known_clean_instance, identified0, prefix_quality1, score0, exact canonical template base_properties and known color1 EquipmentCondition. This origin is a trusted complete fixed clean result, not an unknown legacy approximation; never initialize or infer missing data during identification
item: own carried column1, quantity1, not worn or in warehouse; template in current clean ordinary six-slot DetailRules, non-god-weapon. Exclude special full item kinds0x1c8/0x2c8/0x3c8 with unresolved dynamic level source, advanced/unknown details and unsupported metadata. Preserve slot, binding, quality, condition and every existing result field
fee: positive exact original needmoney at authoritative citemattr.level; no interpolation, level51 fallback, client price or special-kind dynamic-field substitution. Role level does not replace equipment level
insufficient_balance: reject; no bound-silver fallback, mixed payment, debt or partial identification
result: change only known detail identified0 to1; preserve the already fixed base_properties, prefix1, score0, color1, binding, durability and all other supported fields. No additional attributes or skills are generated in this deterministic subset. A different random-result policy needs its own model and authority
wearing: identification does not select role-equipment.v2 or grant wearing rights; later wearing still uses that role's actual current equipment policy and level/class/slot/attribute checks
transaction: dedicated stable admitted confirmation ID and immutable intent; NPC fee plus public Inventory caller-transaction detail CAS, inventory revision, source precommit and common/domain receipts are one current-lease transaction. All current bag/tips/wallet/source replies must be encodable before commit; late failure rolls everything back and the failed stable ID can retry
inventory_mutator: owned Inventory/equipment-detail Interface must re-read exact item ownership/current carried state, persistent detail revision+origin+full before JSON and expected inventory_revision; support identified0 to1 only. NPC must not duplicate private equipment SQL or use one-time initialization as an update
resources: carried item identification leaves equipped caps and absolute HP/MP/death unchanged; synchronize the sole current asset/resource source using the existing accepted-command precommit. Missing or pending source refuses; no healing, profile migration or second resource store
retry: same stable admitted ID and same immutable intent reads current known item/wallet/source and never charges or writes historic details again. Repeated confirmation under the same paid query ticket is not a new fee; a fresh identical wire packet cannot bypass current identified1 rejection. Preserve old receipts when later policies are added
reply: original current item tips/detail and relevant bag/wallet refreshes; encode using known current state, then send logical messages through the actual current connection/scene fence. Do not claim original random success animations or text without their own evidence
startup: freeze exact original NPC/ordinary level/fee/detail sources, strict policy and dedicated cash purpose; schema for dedicated receipts only at startup. Keep original query-only policy unchanged; new settlement binding replaces no other existing handler implicitly
activation: isolated NPC/Inventory domain implementation and temporary-store/native checks authorized. Do not add default unidentified generation, migrate existing items, change runtime registry or deploy this slice before independent source/transaction/shared acceptance
